Hamilton's I-want song with Laurens, Lafayette, and Mulligan.

How My Shot connects

  • Work: Hamilton (musical) — My Shot is Hamilton's first-act I-want song.
  • Character: Alexander Hamilton — Hamilton leads My Shot with Laurens, Lafayette, and Mulligan.
  • Character: John Laurens — John Laurens stands in the My Shot quartet.
  • Character: Marquis de Lafayette — Lafayette stands in the My Shot quartet.
  • Character: Hercules Mulligan — Hercules Mulligan stands in the My Shot quartet.

What is My Shot?

My Shot is the early number in which Hamilton, Laurens, Lafayette, and Mulligan swear they are not throwing away their shot — the thesis song of the first act.

Key threads lead to Hamilton (musical), Alexander Hamilton, John Laurens, Marquis de Lafayette and Hercules Mulligan.
